# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.25

Your own media servers come to StreamDek. Connect Plex, Jellyfin or both, and your films and series
appear on Home, in Search, in Continue Watching and on a new My Media page, and they play straight
from your server.

## What's New

**Plex**
Connect your Plex account in Settings > Sources > Plex. Tap Connect Plex and a code appears. Open
plex.tv/link, or scan the code to open the page with the code already filled in, and approve
StreamDek. The screen notices the approval by itself. Plex is linked to your StreamDek profile, so
every device on that profile gets your libraries.
- See each of your servers and how it is being reached: on your home network, remotely, or through
  Plex Relay.
- Choose which film and series libraries appear. Other video libraries stay off until you switch
  them on.
- Set the most StreamDek asks for when streaming away from home. At home, Direct Play is always
  tried first.
- Refresh libraries, Reconnect or Disconnect at any time. Your choices are saved to your profile.

**Jellyfin**
Sign in to your own Jellyfin server in Settings > Sources > Jellyfin.
- Servers on your home network appear on their own. For a server elsewhere, enter the address you
  use in your browser.
- Sign in with your username and password, or with Quick Connect: enter the code shown in a
  Jellyfin app where you are already signed in.
- Add more than one server, and choose which film and series libraries appear from each.
- Your Jellyfin sign-in stays on this device, stored encrypted. It is not put in StreamDek backups
  or in your StreamDek profile.

**My Media**
While a server is connected, the navigation bar gains a media tab: Home, Search, My Media (or Plex or
Jellyfin when only one is connected), Library and Settings, still five places. The page shows your
Continue Watching, Next Up (Jellyfin), Recently Added, Recently Watched, your libraries, Favourites
(Jellyfin) and Collections. With several servers, rows are grouped by server. With both Plex and
Jellyfin connected, swipe between them or tap the switch at the top, and the page reopens on the
one you used last.
- An optional colour glow behind each page and its lists: purple, blue, red and green for Plex;
  orange and red on black for Jellyfin. Both are on by default, and you can switch them off under
  Plex page and Jellyfin page in each server's settings.
- The header stays in place as you scroll, with nothing behind it. Titles fade out as they reach its
  edge instead of passing behind it.
- A short notice tells you when a server is asleep or has refused access, and one tap takes you to
  its settings.

**Your server's titles everywhere in StreamDek**
- **Home:** server rows can be added in Home Rows. Recently Added is switched on by default.
- **Search:** results from your servers come first.
- **Continue Watching:** titles you are part-way through on a server join your Continue Watching
  once each. When you have been watching the same film elsewhere, the most recent position wins.
- **View all:** a server's rows open onto the whole library, loaded as you scroll. The search field
  carries the Plex or Jellyfin mark, so you always know whose list you are in.

**Title pages and playback**
Server titles open on the normal title page, with Series > Seasons > Episodes for series.
- Pages are filled in from StreamDek's catalogue: logo, trailers, ratings, cast with photos,
  similar titles and where else a title streams. Jellyfin titles with a known TMDB match open
  straight away on StreamDek's TMDB details while your server is asked in the background.
- Streams always come only from your server. StreamDek tries Direct Play, then Direct Stream, then
  Transcode, and each source says which one it is using.
- Your resume point, progress and watched state are read from your server and reported back to it.
  Mark as watched, mark earlier episodes watched and remove from Continue Watching all update your
  server too.
- Plex title pages show **Reviews from Plex**, with each critic's Fresh or Rotten verdict and a link
  to the full review.

## Improvements

**Library shows where you are**
The filter row at the top of Library now names the section you are in. It reads Continue Watching,
and as the Watchlist heading scrolls up it slides into the row and takes over. Each title appears
in Library only once.

**Server rows keep going**
Rows from your servers keep loading as you scroll along them, instead of stopping after the first
20 titles.

**Pages that don't wait on a slow server**
Each server is asked on its own, with its own time limit. A slow or sleeping server no longer holds
up or empties another server's rows. Rows also appear by themselves once a server that was still
waking up connects, without a manual refresh.

**Older Jellyfin servers**
StreamDek works with older Jellyfin servers as well as current ones, falling back to the older way
of asking for your libraries, progress and favourites when a server needs it.

**Clearer when libraries don't load**
If Continue Watching arrives but your libraries don't, the page now says so and shows a short reason
from the server. Tap it to try again.

## Privacy and security

- Plex and Jellyfin access tokens and passwords are never put in web addresses, logs, crash reports,
  analytics or error messages. They are removed from anything StreamDek saves or hands off to
  another device.
- Titles and ids from your servers are not sent to StreamDek's analytics. For a title your server
  can match to TMDB or IMDb, StreamDek looks up only that public id, never your server's own ids.
- Sources from your servers are not offered for download.

## Quick Setup

- **Plex:** Settings > Sources > Plex > Connect Plex, then approve the code at plex.tv/link.
- **Jellyfin:** Settings > Sources > Jellyfin, pick your server or enter its address, then sign in with your
  password or Quick Connect.
- **Choose what appears:** switch libraries on or off in each server's settings, and add server
  rows to Home in Home Rows.
